# DFlow Skills

Domain recipes for DFlow — Solana spot trading, Kalshi prediction markets,
Proof KYC, and builder fees. Field meanings, units, gates, and scan math live
here. Commands live in `../SKILL.md`.

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`dflow-spot-trading`](dflow-spot-trading/SKILL.md) | Solana token swaps: mints, units, slippage, route errors |
| [`dflow-kalshi-trading`](dflow-kalshi-trading/SKILL.md) | Buy, sell, and redeem YES/NO outcome tokens |
| [`dflow-kalshi-market-scanner`](dflow-kalshi-market-scanner/SKILL.md) | Named scans over events, markets, and series |
| [`dflow-kalshi-market-data`](dflow-kalshi-market-data/SKILL.md) | Orderbook, trades, candles, live data |
| [`dflow-kalshi-portfolio`](dflow-kalshi-portfolio/SKILL.md) | Positions, mark-to-market, P&L, redeemable |
| [`dflow-proof-kyc`](dflow-proof-kyc/SKILL.md) | Proof verification for Kalshi buys |
| [`dflow-platform-fees`](dflow-platform-fees/SKILL.md) | `platformFeeBps` / `platformFeeScale` |
